reservation.headline: Your Table Is Confirmed
reservation.intro: Thank you for reserving a table with {locationName}. Your reservation is confirmed, and we're looking forward to welcoming you.
reservation.closing: If your plans change or you have any special requests, please reach out to us on {whatsappLink}. This inbox is unattended, so replying here won't reach us, but we're happy to help there.
reservation.noShowNote: Please note: your table will be held for 30 minutes past the reservation time. If you haven't arrived by then, the booking may be released and treated as cancelled.
reservation.pickupNote: Complimentary pickup service for guests staying around the Nusa Dua area is available (minimum 2 adults per request), subject to availability.

groupReservation.headline: Your Group Reservation Request Has Been Received
groupReservation.intro: Thank you for your group reservation request. We've received your details, and our team will get back to you shortly to confirm availability.
groupReservation.closing: We're looking forward to the opportunity to welcome you, and will follow up shortly to confirm every detail.

contact.headline: Thank You for Writing to Us
contact.intro: Thank you for writing to {locationName}. Your message has reached us safely, and a member of our team will respond to you personally very soon.
contact.closing: We are grateful for your interest in Mr Bob Bar and Grill, and look forward to the opportunity of welcoming you soon.

common.teamName: The Mr Bob Bar and Grill Team
